text: Flood damage to the insured building is excluded unless the optional flood endorsement is purchased.
Losses caused by earthquake, landslide or subsidence are excluded from this policy.
Fire and lightning damage to the premises is covered up to the declared replacement value.
Business interruption cover pays lost net profit for up to twelve months after an insured event.
Terrorism and catastrophic risk exclusions apply to all high-rise commercial buildings.
Water escape from burst pipes is covered, but gradual seepage and rising damp are not.
Vacant premises lose theft and vandalism cover after sixty consecutive days without occupation.
Storm damage to roofs is covered provided the roof was maintained in good repair.
Glass breakage of shopfronts and display windows is covered without an excess.
The policy excludes wear and tear, rust, rot and mechanical breakdown of building services.
Cargo lost to piracy is excluded unless war and strikes clauses are added to the policy.
Goods are insured warehouse to warehouse, including transit by sea, rail and road.
General average contributions are covered when the vessel's master sacrifices cargo to save the voyage.
Insufficient packing or improper stowage by the insured voids cover for the affected consignment.
Refrigerated containers are covered for spoilage caused by machinery failure lasting over twenty-four hours.
Delay in arrival, even when caused by an insured peril, is not covered.
Theft of containers from a port terminal is covered up to the per-container limit.
Jettison and washing overboard of deck cargo are covered under Institute Cargo Clauses A.
Sanctioned destinations and cargo for sanctioned parties are excluded from all cover.
Loss ratio for the marine cargo book is reviewed quarterly against earned premium.
Ransomware extortion payments are reimbursed only with the insurer's prior written consent.
Data breach notification costs and credit monitoring for affected customers are covered.
Acts of war and state-sponsored cyber attacks are excluded.
Business interruption from a network outage is covered after an eight-hour waiting period.
Losses from unpatched systems are excluded if a critical patch was available for over thirty days.
Social engineering fraud, such as a fake supplier invoice, is covered up to a sublimit.
Regulatory fines are covered where insurable by law in the relevant jurisdiction.
Multi-factor authentication on remote access is a condition precedent to cover.
Forensic investigation and incident response costs are covered from the first hour.
Cloud provider outages are covered only when the outage lasts more than twelve hours.
Fleet vehicles are covered for third-party liability while driven by authorised employees.
Racing, rallies and speed trials are excluded from all fleet cover.
Windscreen replacement is covered without affecting the no-claims discount.
Driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs voids cover for the driver involved.
Flood damage to parked vehicles is covered under the comprehensive section.
Goods carried in commercial vans are covered against theft only when the van is locked.
Electric vehicle battery damage from charging faults is covered up to the battery's market value.
Telematics data may be used to settle disputed claims about speed and location.
Hire cars are provided for up to fourteen days while an insured vehicle is repaired.
Wear and tear, mechanical failure and tyre damage from punctures are excluded.
